scoring_policy.why: Explicit support exclusion for science ranking; distances beyond both models retain diagnostics but no posterior or ln R. This is a selection policy, not a fitted outlier fraction.

field_continuation_scope: Original rows and seed; weights refreshed at the published model. Original final-fit weights were not saved.

south.scope: Full observed field before the support gate, conditional on measured r and errors.

verdict.scope: Southern ranking baseline; north remains provisional even if the southern gates pass.
